title: Coach or teacher
summary: For coaches and teachers: a free intro call first, the ways to work with you and what they cost, the weekly schedule, and what students say.

notFor: Consultants selling to companies (start from freelancer)

cards.purpose: The main ask: a free intro.
Ways to work with them, each with a format and price.

slots.ask: What name do you want at the top of the page?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a square photo or logo for your profile picture?
slots.write: The member uploads it in the editor; never fetch one from the web.

slots.ask: How should a new student start: a free call, a trial class, a booking page?
slots.write: Heading = a question their student would ask; first button = the booking link.

slots.ask: What are the ways to work with you? For each: format, length, price if public, and who it is for.
slots.write: tag = length or frequency · price; title = the offer; description = what the student gets.

slots.ask: Do you have regular classes or sessions? When and where?
slots.write: A bulleted list: day time: session, place. Public places only.

slots.ask: Do you have short quotes from students you may publish?
slots.write: Verbatim, attributed as each student agreed (first name only is fine). Never write a quote.
